scope: provider-generated editorial prose only; IDs and inherited refs excluded

thresholds.pass: combined classification matches canonical language, confidence >= 0.8, and dominant field language matches
thresholds.fail: combined classification is the opposite supported language (EN vs FR) with confidence >= 0.8
thresholds.review: mixed, unknown, low confidence, unsupported canonical language, or conflicting field-level scores

note: Gross EN/FR mismatch is the A.3 failure mode this layer must catch. It is not a translation detector and does not score semantic fidelity.
